# Thomas Bi CyberRunner Reference Copy

This folder contains a pristine reference copy from:

https://github.com/thomasbi1/cyberrunner/tree/master

The `cyberrunner_dynamixel` package here is intentionally ignored by colcon so it
does not conflict with the local `cyberrunner_dynamixel` package.

Use this folder for comparing or copying reference Dynamixel code. Do not build
it directly together with the current workspace unless the package is renamed.
